profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ Microsoft
profile.summary: Software engineer currently supporting the SharePoint Online Blob Storage team at Microsoft, following contributions to Azure SQL Hyperscale.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Supports the SharePoint Online Blob Storage team
• Contributed to the development of cloud-native distributed architecture of Azure SQL Hyperscale to enable multi-tenancy in the storage layer and support resource sharing, thereby reducing cost-of-goods-sold (COGS)
• Played a pivotal role in delivering cumulative business and customer savings of >$75 million over the lifecycle of the project
• Acted as scrum master, leading team efforts surrounding incident mitigations, root cause analyses, weekly status reports, backlog grooming, and milestone tracking in collaboration with cross-team stakeholders to drive COGS reduction
• Ensured robustness of the system and project stability by maintaining test health and alerting, enhancing Kusto monitoring dashboards, reducing incident volume, and authoring supportability collaterals
• Developed elastic multi-tenant features across Compute, Log Service, and Page Servers to contribute to project milestones

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
• Collaborated with software engineers on the Uber Eats Growth Messaging team to scalably design, implement, and document an automated push notification system 
• Implemented, tested, and debugged backend functionality of automation in Go and utilized Uber's general-purpose, horizontally scalable database with a MySQL database management system to store and query data necessary for sending a push notification
• Configured data dashboards to monitor errors, gather analytics, and share data visualizations with product and marketing partners

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Supported a team of software engineers and tax analysts in developing a web-based tax and accounting application with AngularJS framework through front-end development in TypeScript/JavaScript and back-end development in C#
• Contributed to the implementation of three new features and resolved at least 30 reported bugs to increase functionality and enhance user experience
• Applied the Agile software development methodology to complete deliverables in a timely manner and adapt to the demands of tax software users
• Increased code coverage by implementing Jasmine unit tests for existing framework and added features
